start.Text: Have you read the latest Jobe Scientist? Beits north of here limp, graze and fight in ways that tell me about the Xan. Observe a Limping Beit, then a regular one, then bring me bones. {givequest JS00}

s0.Text: Observe a Limping Beit first, then a regular Beit, north of here.{completequest JS00}

s1.Text: Good bones. Now I need older ones: Old Beit Bones. They lie nearby. {take JK00}{completequest JS04}

s1_need.Text: Kill three Aggressive Beits and bring me their bones.

s2.Text: The Old Beit Bones are close by. Pick them up.

s3.Text: These confirm it. Technologist Frank Jobin at the Notum Battery Tree will want your help. {take JK01}{completequest JS06}

s3_need.Text: Bring me the Old Beit Bones.

s4.Text: A scan of Yuttos carvings! My bone theory was wrong. I feel tired; bring me a Nucleus of Crusty Eremite. {take JK0Q}{completequest JS50}

s4_need.Text: Dr. Hestiya has a scan for me.

s5.Text: Thank you. Frank Jobin has one last job for you. {take JK0R}{completequest JS52}

s5_need.Text: Crusty Eremites near the Court carry the nucleus.

idle.Text: The Beits north of here have more to teach.
